title: Software R&D Cost Capitalization Without Manual Overhead | Faros

hero.headline: Automate cost capitalization reports
hero.subhead: Faros automates the entire process, generating accurate, audit-ready reports without a single manual spreadsheet.

sections.heading: The challenge — manual cost capitalization drains time
sections.body: Auto-generate periodic reports from digital footprints; real-time tracking (filter by initiative/epic/employee); streamline with clear audit trails, no human intervention.

sections.heading: Our solution
sections.body: Save engineering-leader time (tabulate eligible activities from digital footprints, export for finance); improve accuracy/transparency/defensibility (consistent capitalization rules, reduce non-compliance risk); repeatable/scalable (onboard new managers fast, handle overlapping tasks and poor data hygiene).

notes: Retrieved via Claude-in-Chrome. Software Cost Capitalization is a distinct named sub-capability of Predictable Delivery (faros:delivery-excellence) and a finance-facing surface. Reinforces taxonomy flag. Testimonial: Matt Fisher, VP Product Engineering, Vimeo.
